@@ -55,5 +55,21 @@ jobs:
           key: trussbars-conf-cargo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('trussbars/Cargo.lock') }}
 
       # `spago build` (the interpreter + emitter) then renders + diffs every case.
-      - name: Conformance gate
+      - name: Conformance gate (v1 emit ≡ oracle)
         run: npm run test:trussbars-conformance
+
+      # The v2 Rust pipeline (`truss-emit`) must hit the SAME byte-for-byte golden
+      # as the v1 emitter — including the standalone-whitespace corpus cases.
+      - name: v2 emit gate (v2 ≡ v1, byte-identical)
+        run: npm run test:trussbars-v2
+
+      # The VM backend (`truss-vm`): the lenient tree-walk renders the corpus, and
+      # AOT-compat (strict) mode is a verifying proxy for the AOT subset.
+      - name: VM gates (tree-walk + AOT-compat proxy)
+        run: npm run test:trussbars-vm && npm run test:trussbars-vm-compat
+
+      # The AOT-compat drift gate: the PureScript Lab lint (`MaxBars.Compat`, the
+      # FlatBars Studio Trussbars panel) must agree with the Rust `render_compat`
+      # verifying proxy on every case — so the lint can never mislabel a template.
+      - name: AOT-compat drift gate (PureScript lint ⇔ Rust render_compat)
+        run: npm run check:trussbars-compat

@@ -72,6 +72,10 @@
     "clean": "rimraf output .spago",

+    "test:trussbars-vm": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --vm",

     "gen:trussbars-snapshots": "spago build && node trussbars/conformance/harness.mjs --update",
     "test:minbars-spec": "spago build && node packages/minbars/test/spec-conformance.mjs",
